.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-28-cleaning-site-redesign/task-1-brief.md

1. No content text changes. Not one character of any user-facing string in any of the 7 locales (ru, en, fr, it, es, de, nl). Translation objects are read-only.

7. Serve over HTTP to test: `python -m http.server 8000` from the project root (the command is `python`, NOT `python3`, on this machine).

ENVIRONMENT CONSTRAINT — important, this changes your verification:
There is NO node, npm, npx, or headless browser on this machine. You CANNOT run the browser-based verification steps in the brief (Step 4's DevTools console snippets, clicking links, document.fonts.check). Do NOT attempt them, do NOT install anything, and do NOT report them as passing.

- grep-based checks that the five hrefs now read `#/services` etc. and that `#/` is used for home
- grep that index.html no longer contains id="header-container", id="main-content", or id="footer-container"
- grep that index.html contains the two preconnect links and the Google Fonts stylesheet link
- confirm the <title>, the lang script, and the HTML comments are unchanged
- confirm js/app.js was NOT modified
The browser verification is deferred to a final visual pass run by the controller. Report the browser steps as DEFERRED, not as passed.
